doc.title: Roscoe Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2023

title: Everything goes in a circle; staying optimistic
summary: He says his recent music resonates and that he aligns with people thinking similarly and prefers looking for yes.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Looking back: no regrets, what it all meant

blocks.x: There was another, going back to this interview you did in 1998, you said, “Everything goes in a circle.” You were talking about the 60s before and we’re in the 90s now, that’s a complete circle. I believe you were talking about how music was being accepted. And where are we on the circle now? Do you think that the music that you’ve created recently is resonating with a significant audience?

Oh absolutely. Yeah. Every day I get up just something will happen. You know? I mean it’s kind of — and then I try to align myself with people that are thinking in a similar way because there’s a lot of people, and it’s a good time to make a connection with people. You know? So yeah, I tend to lean on that side of things.
You sound like you’re an optimist?

I am. I mean I’m not going to be a pessimist, that’s no fun. You know. I mean like if you are saying no, I can’t use you. I’m looking for somebody saying yes. Why do I want to be bothered with no? You know? Because there’s a lot of people out there, and I know this is true, there’s a lot of people out there saying yes.
